news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Nektar disclosed that on August 20 it granted 25,200 stock options plus 5,000 RSUs to eleven newly hired employees under the 2025 Inducement Plan, with an exercise price of $74.53 matching that day's close. The steady stream of inducement grants is the clearest public marker of the headcount build behind the three-trial ZENITH AD Phase 3 program.

news.headline: Nektar's (NKTR) Billion-Dollar Balance Sheet Faces A Multi-Year Test
news.summary: The piece frames the bear case: $1.02 billion of cash funds a wait of roughly two years to mid-2028 AD data and into second-half 2029 for the 850-patient alopecia areata Phase 3, against full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million and revenue capped near $45 million, mostly non-cash royalties. Short interest stands at about 19.9% of float and hedge fund holders fell from 56 to 50 quarter over quarter.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results of Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: The Lancet published the full 16-week induction dataset from the 393-patient REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b across 107 sites in 10 countries: mean EASI reduction of 61% on 24 ug/kg q2w versus 31% on placebo (p<0.0001), with EASI-75 at 42% versus 17%. Serious adverse events occurred in 2% of participants with no deaths and no signal for infections or conjunctivitis, the first peer-reviewed validation that selective Treg expansion produces clinically meaningful skin outcomes.

news.headline: JPMorgan Initiates Coverage on Nektar Therapeutics with Neutral Rating and $65 Price Target
news.summary: JPMorgan started NKTR at Neutral with a $65 target, roughly 14% below the prior close and the second cautious voice after Wedbush's $80. It sits far under a consensus 12-month target near $150, where the sell-side skews Buy and Piper Sandler is highest at $192.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Cash and investments stood at $1,023.4 million on June 30, 2026 versus $245.8 million at year-end 2025, helped by the $373.8 million April equity raise, extending runway into Q3 2028 and past the targeted mid-2028 ZENITH AD readout. Net loss was $40.6 million ($1.23 per share) against an operating loss of $42.3 million, revenue of $10.1 million just missed consensus, and management reaffirmed a Phase 3 alopecia areata start in early 2027 and a first rezpegaldesleukin BLA in 2029.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program for Rezpegaldesleukin in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
news.summary: Nektar began randomizing patients in ZENITH AD-1 and AD-2, two 510-patient global registrational trials in biologic/JAK-naive patients aged 12 and older, part of a roughly 1,530-patient program across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. The design followed FDA end-of-Phase 2 meetings and EMA scientific advice, targeting initial topline data in mid-2028 and a BLA in 2029.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 initiation (biologic/JAK-experienced patients)
catalysts.detail: The third roughly 510-patient Phase 3 study, enrolling patients with prior systemic biologic and/or JAK inhibitor treatment experience, is guided to begin in September 2026. It completes the registrational package for both U.S. and European filings and tests rezpeg in the harder-to-treat population that already failed Dupixent or a JAK. Confirmation of the start is the next concrete, dateable company milestone.

catalysts.label: Two oral presentations at EADV Congress 2026, Vienna
catalysts.detail: Nektar has two accepted oral presentations at the 35th EADV Congress: Thomas Bieber on durable and deepening improvements with monthly and quarterly dosing from the REZOLVE-AD maintenance part, and David Rosmarin on 52-week Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA results in severe-to-very-severe alopecia areata. Maintenance durability at reduced dosing frequency is the main commercial differentiator versus Dupixent, so the dermatology community's reaction here matters more than the raw numbers.

catalysts.label: First NKTR-0165 (TNFR2 agonist) preclinical data at a scientific conference
catalysts.detail: Management has guided to presenting preclinical data for NKTR-0165, its bivalent TNFR2 agonist antibody, at a scientific conference in the second half of 2026. It is the only pipeline asset behind rezpeg and is paired with a February 2026 research collaboration with UCSF and Dr. Stephen Hauser in multiple sclerosis. Venue and date are not yet named.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: The next quarterly report should update cash burn against full-year R&D guidance of $210-230 million, confirm the ZENITH AD-3 start and give first enrollment colour across all three AD studies, and detail preparations for the early-2027 alopecia areata Phase 3. Exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Phase 3 alopecia areata study start (~850 patients)
catalysts.detail: Management reaffirmed on the Q2 call that it will start a single registrational Phase 3 in severe alopecia areata in early 2027, sized at roughly 850 patients, based on the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA proof-of-concept (28.2% mean SALT reduction on 24 ug/kg q2w versus 11.2% placebo at 36 weeks). Rezpeg already holds FDA Fast Track in this indication, and the readout is guided to the second half of 2029.

catalysts.label: First ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline readout
catalysts.detail: Initial registrational efficacy data for rezpeg in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, the decisive binary event for the equity. Cash runway extends into Q3 2028, so the company reaches this readout without a further raise. A repeat of the 61%-vs-31% EASI delta at Phase 3 scale is what the consensus target near $150 is discounting.

catalysts.label: First rezpegaldesleukin BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Nektar has publicly guided to a first BLA filing for rezpegaldesleukin in atopic dermatitis in 2029, following the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline. The program was designed with EMA scientific advice in parallel, so a European filing is intended off the same dataset.

pulse: Nektar remains a single-asset late-stage story where financing is settled and the pivotal read is roughly two years out: $1.02 billion of cash at June 30 funds runway into Q3 2028, past the mid-2028 ZENITH AD topline, with ZENITH AD-3 due to start in September 2026 and an ~850-patient alopecia areata Phase 3 in early 2027. Shares trade in the mid-$70s, roughly $2.4-2.5 billion market cap, well below the 52-week high near $109, even after The Lancet's August 25 publication of the REZOLVE-AD Phase 2b induction data (61% versus 31% mean EASI reduction, EASI-75 of 42% versus 17%, clean safety) put independent peer review behind the drug. The market is trading the funding gap, not the data: sell-side consensus targets cluster near $150 with Piper Sandler at $192, while newer initiations from JPMorgan ($65 Neutral) and Wedbush ($80) stay cautious, short interest sits near 20% of float, and the next concrete catalysts are the ZENITH AD-3 start and two rezpeg oral presentations at EADV in Vienna from September 30.
